text: Testing is a crucial part of modern software development. Two main types of tests help ensure quality: unit tests, which check small, individual pieces of code, and integration tests, which verify that different parts of a program work together correctly. Many developers use test-driven development, a method where you write a failing test first, then write the minimum code to make it pass. This approach encourages clear, simple design. Ultimately, a solid testing strategy gives programmers confidence. When they can run a full test suite and see everything pass, they feel secure making changes, fixing bugs, and adding new features without fear of breaking something that already works.
